column1: # SOURCE: https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-10  (page title: "NFL Week 10 Schedule 2026: Games, Times, Matchups & Tickets")
# Read via the fetch tool, chunks 0-1 of 2, on 2026-11-19 (UTC). Transcribed by session arena/427c1843-x1 (round 7).
# One row per fixture as PRINTED by the official page on 2026-11-19. All 14 Week 10 fixtures print status "Final".
# away_record / home_record are the club records printed beside each club logo on THIS page; all 32 club records
# (28 in game blocks + 4 in the bye block: CHI 7-2, DEN 7-2, PHI 2-7, TB 3-6) are cross-checked against the
# separate official standings page read the same day (official_standings_2026_11_19.tsv) by
# Records print without the tie segment when the club has no ties (e.g. PATRIOTS5-5); transcribed as printed.
# time_et / network blank: the completed-game blocks print "Final / Nov 15" (etc.) and this read captured no
# kickoff-time or network string. Blank is not an inference.
# venue: the weekly schedule page prints a venue only for the international game (Munich, in the event header);
# the others are printed only by each game's own Game Center page, so the column stays blank rather than guessed.
